traits.name: Stench
traits.text: (aura, olfactory); 30 feet. A creature that enters the area must attempt a DC 16 Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is sickened 1, and on a critical failure, the creature also takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. While within the aura, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to saves to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all xulgaths' stenches for 1 minute.

traits.name: Stench Suppression
traits.text: ⭓ A xulgath skulker can suppress its stench aura as a free action to better hide its presence. The skulker can resume its stench aura as a free action.

traits.name: Hidden Movement
traits.text: If a xulgath skulker starts its turn undetected by a creature or merely hidden from it, that creature is flat-footed against the skulker's attacks until the end of the skulker's turn.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: A xulgath skulker deals an additional 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.
